newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales to total $2.23 bln week of Sept 16.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales to total $2.23 bln week of Sept 16.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales are expected to total $2.23 billion in 86 offerings for the week of Sept 16, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales for the week are expected to total about $948 million in 54 offerings. The largest is a $200 million Massachusetts deal set for Sept 18.

Negotiated sales, depending on market conditions, could total $1.29 billion in 32 offerings for the week. The largest issue is expected to be a $200 million San Diego County Regional Transportation Commission, Calif., deal via Smith Barney Inc.
An additional $1.4 billion of deals are on the Reuters day-to-day negotiated calendar, meaning underwriters have said they may decide to price the issues depending on market conditions.
